name: parley
description: Multi-party decisions for agents: red lines rejected in code, max-min pick, SHA-256 receipt.
long_description: Give the options and each party's red lines and soft preferences. An option that crosses any red line is rejected in code; among the options acceptable to everyone the max-min rule picks the one whose least-satisfied party is best off. No acceptable option gives an honest deadlock. The receipt is an unsigned SHA-256 over the transcript: it shows the record was not altered, not who produced a verdict. In this mode the host holds every party's spec, so there is no privacy between parties.

tools.name: parley_decide
tools.description: Reach a decision among parties with conflicting interests; red lines are checked in code.

tools.name: parley_verify_receipt
tools.description: Check a transcript against its SHA-256 receipt.

tools.name: parley_check_party
tools.description: Replay one party's own sheet against a transcript to check none of its red lines was crossed.
